jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Inference
jobs.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com .   We re proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.   What You ll Do: CoreWeave’s Inference team builds and operates the core cloud platform powering massive-scale GPU workloads for AI/ML, VFX, rendering, and real-time inference. Our stack is engineered for speed, scale, and cost efficiency—providing a powerful alternative to traditional hyperscalers where infrastructure is our core product operated at massive scale. About the role:   As a Staff Software Engineer on the Inference team, you will operate as a technical leader across multiple teams and services, driving architecture, performance, and reliability for CoreWeave’s Kubernetes-native inference platform. You will define and lead complex, cross-cutting design initiatives spanning request routing, adaptive scheduling, GPU resource management, and cost-per-token optimisation under strict P99 SLAs. In this high-impact role, you will implement advanced inference optimisations—such as speculative decoding and KV-cache reuse—while establishing performance benchmarking frameworks, guiding cross-functional alignment across infrastructure boundaries, and raising the bar for engineering rigour and observability practices across the organisation. jobs.title: Senior Director, ML Software
jobs.description: About the job Set the direction for Graphcore’s ML software, with accountability for organisational leadership, investment priorities and delivery across platform generations. As Senior Director of ML Software in Bristol, you’ll report to the VP of Software. Your organisation delivers the machine learning software and analysis tools that enable AI models to run on Graphcore’s platform. You’ll translate business objectives into multi year roadmaps, aligning resources, investment and delivery commitments. You’ll own outcomes from early platform bring-up through production release and support. Your remit spans machine learning frameworks, kernel libraries, hardware simulation, networking software, profiling and debugging tools. You’ll lead through senior engineering leaders, shape organisational structure and develop successors. Beyond your function, you’ll shape wider software priorities, influence executive decisions and sponsor initiatives across the organisation.  The team and culture You’ll partner with silicon, hardware, architecture, system software, product and operations leaders to align roadmaps and resolve integration risks. With architecture leaders, you’ll challenge design assumptions across frameworks, simulation, collectives and tooling. Your leadership team will own achievable, adequately resourced plans, with clear expectations for milestones, quality and outcomes. jobs.description: About Us Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.   About the Team Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. jobs.description: Job Title: Software Engineer Location: London/Hybrid.                  Type: Full-time Level: Mid Level                                  Reports to: EMS Engineering Lead We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our team responsible for designing, building, and optimising a next-generation multi-region, multi-tenanted Execution Management System (EMS) platform. The ideal candidate will have experience building concurrent, performance sensitive systems where correctness and high availability are maintained across multiple regions to meet the stringent demands of our global trading customers. Key Responsibilities Platform Development: Design and implement low-latency, high-throughput systems for a multi-region, multi-tenanted EMS platform, ensuring compliance with industry standards. Latency Optimisation: Analyse and optimise critical paths in the system to reduce latency and improve performance. Multi-Tenancy & Isolation: Develop scalable architectures to ensure strong tenant isolation, data security and resource fairness in multi-tenant environments. Distributed Systems: Maintain distributed, fault-tolerant systems with high availability across multiple regions, ensuring data consistency and low-latency communication. Monitoring & Observability: Implement real-time monitoring, telemetry and alerting systems for proactive issue detection and resolution. Collaboration: Work closely with product, QA and infrastructure teams to align technical solutions with business requirements and ensure seamless deployments. R&D: Stay ahead of industry trends and incorporate emerging technologies, tools, and best practices to continuously enhance the platform. jobs.title: Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d), Teil- oder Vollzeit, Remote
jobs.description: Über AZAV Pilot Unsere Vision: Jede(r) sollte lehren und lernen können. Mit AZAV Pilot können sich Bildungsanbieter in der Erwachsenenbildung auf das konzentrieren, was wirklich zählt: fantastische Kurse & Coachings für ihre Kundinnen und Kunden anzubieten, anstatt im Bürokratiesumpf zu versinken. Wir entwickeln das Betriebssystem für alles rund um die Verwaltung der Teilnehmenden, die Dokumentation von Anwesenheit und Klassenbuch sowie das Qualitätsmanagement. Wir sind profitabel, 100 % bootstrapped und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d). Wenn du es liebst, Probleme tief zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit Kunden Lösungen zu entwickeln, die kurzfristig umgesetzt werden, bist du bei uns richtig! Die Stelle ist in Teil- oder Vollzeit (mindestens 30h / Woche) remote, mit der Möglichkeit, jederzeit in unserem Büro in Berlin Charlottenburg zu arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Bisher kümmert sich unser CPO Jakob neben seinen anderen Aufgaben selbst um das Design der Plattform. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die das ganz übernimmt und die Sicht unserer Nutzer:innen in jede Produktentscheidung einbringt. Du hast Freude daran, Projekte eigenständig zu übernehmen? Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch? Du machst gerne Research, testest Prototypen und kannst Anforderungen klar an die Entwicklung kommunizieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Product Designer UX/UI für unser Product Team. Konkret verantwortest du Folgendes: Du sprichst mit den Nutzer:innen unseres Produkts und findest heraus, wo es hakt. Du machst aus Research klare Problemstellungen, Personas und Journeys. Du baust Prototypen und testest sie mit echten Nutzer:innen. Du gestaltest Flows und Interfaces für Web und Mobile. Du kommunizierst Anforderungen nachvollziehbar an die Entwicklung. Du machst Designentscheidungen im Team nachvollziehbar und stehst für gute UX ein. Qualifikation 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in UX/UI- oder Product Design

Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints. jobs.title: FPGA Engineer Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Our drones carry more cameras than a single processor can take in, and your job is to show how an FPGA can close that gap. You will own the work end to end, from first design to a demonstrator on the bench. Your results will set how cameras are connected in our next hardware generation. Responsibilities Integrate existing IP cores, write HDL wrappers, simulate and validate FPGA logic that merges multiple camera streams into one. Investigate the system’s limits in camera count, resolution and frame rate. Build the processor-side pipeline that splits the merged stream so each camera stays independently usable. Debug the full chain, from cables and connectors to FPGA logic and camera software on the processor. Deliver a complete demonstrator and documentation that guide our next hardware design. Candidate Requirements Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems. Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging. Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus. Ideally, previous exposure to video or camera interfaces. Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running.

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Bienvenue chez Maison MGA une entreprise où l’innovation rencontre l’excellence humaine. Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est vivre une aventure professionnelle portée par la bienveillance, le challenge, la progression continue… et une bonne dose de convivialité ! Tu intégreras notre entité MGA MedTech basé à Mably (42) spécialisée dans le développement de solutions technologiques avancées dédiées au secteur médical et des dispositifs médicaux. Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ? Pour accompagner notre développement, nous proposons un stage de 4 à 6 mois en Microfabrication et procédés de fabrication de puces microfluidiques. Ton environnement et mission principale Sous la responsabilité du Chargé de microfabrication et consommable Single Use, tu interviens sur le développement et l’amélioration des procédés de fabrication de puces microfluidiques, en PDMS et en thermoplastiques. Pour cela, tu auras l’opportunité de : Développer et optimiser la fabrication de puces PDMS en vue d’une production en série, en concevant des solutions techniques pour simplifier et fiabiliser le procédé, et en quantifiant les gains (temps de fabrication, taux de rebut). Mettre au point un procédé d’embossage à chaud de thermoplastique (PMMA, COC et COP) et caractériser la qualité des microstructures obtenues. Mettre au point un système de connectique robuste et reproductible pour les puces en plastique. Rédiger les procédures de fabrication et de contrôle dans le cadre du système qualité ISO 13485 de l’entreprise. ♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ? Tu es étudiant.e en micro et nanotechnologies, microfabrication ou génie des procédés. Si tu as déjà travaillé en salle blanche ou fabriqué des puces microfluidiques en PDMS, c’est un vrai plus ! Tu maîtrises l’anglais technique : tu es à l’aise pour lire des publications scientifiques et des fiches techniques. Si tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent et participer au développement de technologies innovantes à impact, nous serons

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Training & Experimentation
jobs.description: Who We Are Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction. Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in. We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute. The Way We Work The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here s what that looks like in practice: Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping. Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through. Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together. Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work. Raise the Bar: We re always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most. Think Long-Term: We design for what s next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.   What We re Looking For The Training & Experimentation team at Lightning AI builds the platform that enables developers to experiment at scale and train their own intelligence.

jobs.title: Audiobook QA Expert, Dutch
jobs.description: About the Role Join an AI evaluation team helping improve Dutch text-to-speech audiobook narration. You will listen closely to audiobook samples and identify issues that affect accuracy, naturalness, and the overall listening experience. What You'll Do Listen to AI-narrated audiobooks in Dutch and assess the narration for naturalness, accuracy, and enjoyment. Identify and log skipped, added, or mispronounced words, incorrectly read numbers, misread abbreviations, unnatural phrasing or intonation, and audio artifacts. Categorize issues and mark their exact locations using review tools. Share feedback on overall listener satisfaction and where narration supports or disrupts the experience. Maintain careful, consistent review across extended listening sessions. What We're Looking For Native or near-native fluency in Dutch as spoken in the Netherlands. Working English skills sufficient to write clear reports and communicate with a team. Experience in annotation, labeling, transcription, proofreading, linguistics, or other detail-oriented review work. No specific number of years is stated. Regular audiobook listening and informed opinions about what makes a strong listening experience. Ability to identify speech synthesis errors, categorize them, and mark precise audio spans using review tools. Strong attention to detail and accuracy during long listening sessions. Prior AI training data, model evaluation, or audio QA annotation experience is helpful, as is a background in language, editing, voice, or audio production. Compensation & Benefits $15 to $20 per hour for approximately 20 hours per week. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Remote, based in the Netherlands. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Who is Artefact? Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design. Main Responsibilities As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact? Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do. Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers. Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps. Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide. Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Arte

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. The Role As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering. No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams. Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments Responsibilities Lead us

Ce département est central chez Matera, et nécessite de bien communiquer et de se synchroniser avec les équipes Commerciale, et les équipes d’experts Juristes, Travaux, Comptables etc., afin de garantir une satisfaction client optimale ! Tu reprends en main la relation client dès leur signature de contrat avec l’équipe Commerciale. jobs.description: We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities. It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales. With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. Operational finance and business plan (70%) : Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks. Own the annual budget , built with every team lead, and the business plan , updated every month after the close, for France and Germany. Own cash : the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms. Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee ( garantie financière ) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf ( fonds mandants ). jobs.description: Fullstack DevOps Engineer In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations. Our team enables the use of verifiable information in business processes: eID, verifiable credentials, organization identity, KYB, digital signatures, PDF validation, trust chains, and secure onboarding flows. Many trust, verification, and compliance processes are still manual, fragmented, and costly. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product owners, business stakeholders, UX specialists, and ecosystem partners to turn complex trust and compliance topics into reliable production services. What impact will you have? Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot. Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products. Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation. Model and manage data across relational and/or NoSQL databases with a focus on reliability, traceability, and performance. Integrate frontend applications with robust APIs, authentication, authorization, and secure data flows. Contribute to frontend features where needed using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. Take end-to-end DevOps ownership: from implementation and automated testing to deployment, monitoring, incident handling, and continuous improvement. jobs.title: Kundenbetreuer:in Beschwerdemanagement (Remote, Telefon)
jobs.description: Über Simplyright Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Viele Kundinnen und Kunden nutzen dafür unseren Service und unser Abo Simplyright+. Wenn dabei einmal etwas schiefläuft, soll sich sofort ein Mensch persönlich darum kümmern. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit. Das bieten wir 2.500 € Gehalt pro Monat. Arbeitszeiten: Montag - Freitag von 08:30 - 17:00 Uhr. 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. jobs.description: UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services . We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. We are a certified B Corporation , upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society. ✨ Our values Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy. Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients. The role 🔍 One wrong number in a pitch deck can cost a banker a client. Our users send pitch decks, financial models and investment reports to clients every day, and AI now writes a growing part of them. Someone has to make sure what goes out is right. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us! About You: Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for no

jobs.title: Full stack developer (on site)
jobs.description: Our developers build the systems our customers use to shop for groceries — as well as the software that runs our warehouses, supports last-mile, and helps our purchasing and commerce teams operate effectively. What you'll do We build software in a lean and pragmatic way, and care about choosing the right abstractions for our domain and continuously balance delivery speed against long-term complexity. Our stack includes Typescript, React Native, modern PHP and PostgreSQL. We prefer to work with people who have seen—or want to learn—different technologies, as we consider our tools a means to an end. You will: Work with a small team of product owners and product designers to implement new app features. Help validate features work as intended, from analysing technical telemetry to joining customer interviews. Code across our stack — frontend and backend. Ship often and take responsibility for your code “in the field” . We invest heavily in automated testing and code readability. Refactoring is part of the job. Abstractions are revisited when the business changes. We use LLMs as productivity tools where appropriate, but every line of code shipped to production is understood and owned by the developer who commits it. What you bring You likely: Have several years of experience with developing for mobile. Have real experience with a general-purpose language (Python, JavaScript, PHP, Go, ...). Care about code quality and long-term maintainability. Enjoy working directly with product designers and our customers. Are comfortable taking responsibility for production systems. Bonus points for: Experience with React Native. Experience chasing and solving delicate performance issues on Android or iOS. Experience operating systems serving a large user base. Don’t worry if you don’t match every point above. We hire for long-term potential, curiosity and the ability to learn quickly. A minimum of B2 level Dutch working proficiency and a full-time availability of 36-40 hours per week

Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community. While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. jobs.title: Senior Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology , we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platform with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by tier one investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. Our internal R&D programs generate a steady stream of open questions, about tumor biology, about the patient-derived models we generate across indications, and about how those models behave under drug exposure. Answering these questions takes real analytical firepower. These questions sit in different programmes across the company and run on different timelines. What you'll do You'll work alongside domain experts in cell biology, translational science, organoid establishment, drug screening, and data engineering. You will be part of the team that decides how the question gets tackled, from experimental design through interpretation. Turn analyses into actionable answers that keep programme and product decisions moving, with reasoning solid enough to hold up to scrutiny. Inform key programs (e.g. protocol design, commercial readiness) through deep cross analysis of molecular, functional and clinical data You will communicate your results to internal and external stakeholders: publication-quality

jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. About the Role Improving the quantity and quality of biological data is one of the most challenging bottlenecks to accelerate the rate of scientific discoveries in biology. In our labs at Orakl Oncology, we grow cancer cells from real patients, at scale, to generate our own experimental data. This data is deeply multi-modal and ranges from microscopic images, experimental metadata, to viability data and beyond. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the wet-lab data chain end-to-end: from raw instrument and screening outputs through to processing pipelines. You will work on the canonical data model for lab data, as well as building the validated, analysis-ready datasets and tools our scientists and downstream teams rely on. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role at the intersection of data science, production engineering, and experimental biology. You will ship and maintain code in production, define how we model experimental data, and build the quality controls and feedback loops that let the lab catch errors early and iterate faster. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. jobs.description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live. What You'll Do Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them. Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers. jobs.title: Strategic Finance Intern
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads.

jobs.title: Tech Recruiter
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Anderco

jobs.description: Je gaat werken aan complexe bestaande applicaties binnen de economische statistieken, waar ook een heel nieuw IT product om de hoek komt kijken en je een bijdrage aan kan gaan leveren! Waar jij het verschil maakt De IT producten waar je aan werkt dragen bij aan statistieken over de bouw, industrie, transport, de zakelijke dienstverlening en bijvoorbeeld de motor- en autohandel. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor IT vakmanschap in het team te brengen, en daarmee bestaande en nieuwe IT producten te ontwikkelen en onderhouden. Ook heb je contacten met gebruikers en werk je samen in en soms buiten je team. Je werkt in een team met een agile werkwijze waar ieder teamlid onder meer een verantwoordelijkheid heeft in het continu verbeteren en leren. Je toekomstige collega's Je team bestaat uit een PO, gedeelde Scrum master en in totaal vijf gedreven developers. Ze werken graag samen op kantoor en lopen een rondje buiten in de pauzes. Op maandagen en dinsdagen zijn de vaste team kantoordagen. Sommige collega’s werken vaker op kantoor. Dit ben jij Je bent een ervaren developer met een flexibele instelling. De context van het werk binnen het team vragen om het willen leren en openstaan voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Feitelijk goed geregeld Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. jobs.title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
jobs.description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed

jobs.title: Logistiek Teamleider
jobs.description: Logistiek Teamleider 32-40 uur Ben jij een natuurlijke aanpakker die graag het overzicht houdt, collega's weet te motiveren en energie krijgt van een dynamische logistieke omgeving? Vind je het daarnaast leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, werkzaamheden te coördineren en samen met je team iedere dag het beste resultaat neer te zetten? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou! Als Logistiek Teamleider bij BERG ben jij een belangrijke schakel in onze logistieke operatie. Je stuurt dagelijks een team van Logistiek Medewerkers aan, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt ervoor dat de goederenstroom soepel, veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer, werkt waar nodig zelf mee en weet collega's op een positieve manier te begeleiden, motiveren en ontwikkelen. Bij BERG maken we buiten zijn nóg leuker met onze skelters, trampolines, speeltoestellen en ander kwalitatief buitenspeelgoed. Vanuit onze passie voor actief buitenspelen werken we iedere dag samen aan één doel: The outdoors is yours! Create your future Als Lead Warehouse ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele aansturing van een team van circa 15 Logistiek Medewerkers. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat de logistieke werkzaamheden volgens planning, werkinstructies, veiligheidsregels en kwaliteitsnormen worden uitgevoerd. Je bent het aanspreekpunt op de werkvloer, houdt overzicht over de dagelijkse operatie en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat er moet gebeuren. Je combineert leidinggeven met zelf meewerken en weet als geen ander hoe belangrijk een goede samenwerking is om resultaten te behalen. Naast het coördineren van de werkzaamheden, speel je een belangrijke rol in het begeleiden, coachen en ontwikkelen van medewerkers, uitzendkrachten en nieuwe collega's. Je stimuleert zelfstandigheid, geeft feedback en draagt bij aan een veilige, prettige en productieve werkomgeving. Wat ga je doen? · Je coördineert de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en personeelsbezetting; · Je verdeelt taken, bewaakt de voort

Wil jij onderdeel worden van een familie van bouwers, ontwikkelaars en actievelingen? Dan ben je bij BERG aan het juiste adres! Wij zijn BERG! Altijd op zoek naar de nieuwste producten en innovaties om mensen van alle leeftijden naar buiten te krijgen. Maar in dit geval, zijn wij op zoek naar jou! take control Wij voelen ons thuis, zodra we buiten zijn. Om buiten zijn nog leuker te maken ontwikkelen en produceren wij het meest innovatieve en kwalitatieve buitenspeelgoed voor jong en oud. Dit alles met een hoge fun factor! Als stagiair of afstudeerder ga jij hier aan bijdragen door geweldige ideeën uit te werken. Bij BERG zijn we altijd aan het innoveren. Speelplezier, veiligheid en kwaliteit zijn de drie pilaren waar ons succes op rust. De afdeling R&D is daarmee verantwoordelijk voor alle ontwikkeling van de producten. Het jonge team van 14 personen ontwikkelt de producten intern en maakt ze klaar voor productie. R&D is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van A tot Z en heeft hierbij de beschikking over WACOM tablets, Adobe pakket, SW, Keyshot, 3D prints, een werkplaats met prototypebouwer, en nog veel meer… you got this Vanaf februari 2027 hebben we plaats voor een enthousiaste en gemotiveerde student HBO/WO Industrieel Product Ontwerp, die beschikt over de nodige technische kennis en feeling heeft voor design. Je bent analytisch ingesteld, kent SolidWorks van binnen en buiten. Daarnaast maak je van ideeën en concepten, visuele werkelijkheden. what’s in it for you? BERG biedt jou een leerzame en uitdagende stageplaats of afstudeerplek waar jij als student veel ervaring op kan doen in productontwikkeling binnen een innovatieve en internationale organisatie. Jouw vooruitgang staat centraal en je leert hoe jij je persoonlijke doelen en de doelen van de organisatie kan waarmaken. Daarnaast staan wij garant voor ee

jobs.title: Werkstudent Copywriter
jobs.description: In een notendop Picnic is een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Europa. Als moderne melkboer maken we elke dag duizenden klanten blij met hun boodschappen. Dat doen we verser, goedkoper en groener dan anderen. Onze klanten doen boodschappen en plannen hun maaltijden in onze app en vervolgens bezorgen wij alles gratis thuis. Zonder omweg via de winkel, in elektrische autootjes, met een grote glimlach. Toch is onze website minstens zo belangrijk. Het is dé plek waar we nieuwe klanten naar de app trekken. En daar hebben we jouw hulp bij nodig! Als Copywriter Werkstudent schrijf je heldere, wil-ik-verder-lezen-webteksten: van pagina’s die onze diensten uitleggen tot tips-en-trickspagina’s en zo nu en dan wat SEO. De kunst van het vak Webcopy: Je schrijft teksten waar je zelf op zou doorklikken. Van pagina’s over onze diensten tot recepttips en inspirerende verhalen over onze makers. De juiste toon: Die weet jij wel te vinden. Want hallo, een tekst over paasrecepten vraagt om iets heel anders dan een verhaal over onze nieuwste appfunctie. Samenwerken: Je spart graag met collega’s, maar gaat net zo graag zelf op onderzoek uit. Samen maken jullie onze website steeds een beetje beter.  Blijven leren: Je leert van ervaren copywriters, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en ontdekt gaandeweg wat een webtekst écht goed maakt. Je schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en wordt blij van taal, woorden en zinnen die precies kloppen. Spreek je ook nog ein bisschen Duits? Dat is een plus! Je vindt het leuk om langere teksten te schrijven en maakt complexe informatie graag behapbaar. Je hebt gevoel voor structuur: je weet hoe je een tekst logisch opbouwt en online prettig leesbaar maakt. Je hebt gevoel voor humor, al vind je het wat ongemakkelijk om dat over jezelf te zeggen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Picnic perks  🥗Verse

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Operations & Supply Chain
jobs.description: En bref   Chez Picnic, notre croissance opérationnelle en France s’accélère : plusieurs nouvelles zones logistiques sont prévues dès fin 2026 et début 2027. En tant que Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain & Opérations , tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques. Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic. Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité. Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus. Tes missions   Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs. Accompagner notre expansion en France : tu recrutes les profils clés qui permettront l’ouverture et le développement de nos nouveaux sites logistiques. Définir ta stratégie de recrutement : tu identifies les bons profils, marchés et canaux de sourcing, et adaptes ton approche en fonct

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
jobs.description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète.
